description: Use this when the user asks who is out, what an absence changes, or who benefits when a player sits ('Lakers injury report', 'what if Haliburton is out'). Returns the league injury report, or for a player_id the shift in his team's win probability and spread and the teammates whose minutes or target/carry share rises. Not for a player's own injury status alone (player_profile has it).

player_id.description: Optional numeric player ID to inspect his absence consequences (who absorbs his minutes/targets and how the projection moves). Omit for the league injury report.

name: injury_consequences
title: Injury Report & Absence Consequences
